protocol.purpose: User-authorized broad30000-user scenario census and expanded real-quality evaluation
protocol.selection: Read30000 UID inventory; detailed temporal scan excludes all existing confirmation/reserved-confirmation UIDs. No model outputs or feedback label values used in selection
protocol.strata: Frozen benchmark_01 short/old_lineage/mixed/rare_activity at each release; all flags retained and overlaps explicit
protocol.new_cohorts: 2048 hash-random fresh development UIDs including inactive; up to512 additional active UIDs per short/old_lineage/mixed/rare_activity stratum, disjoint after natural draw; report actual quotas and sampling frame
protocol.activity: Enriched benchmark requires a recorded scoring request in an exposed target window; this conditions evaluation support, is not an online scheduling input, and does not inspect label values
protocol.frozen_methods: Existing225 first-risk excursion and one predeclared persistent-observation candidate. Same C/H/12groups/coefficients/thresholds/0.5commit; no parameter search on expanded outcomes
protocol.persistent_observation: After first screened Current construction with nonsevere error, keep that target-native cache through real appends and requests until release changes or first severe observed discrepancy; install same cache if severe. Pay all shadow appends and extra reads; no repeated target rebuild
protocol.metrics: Per-target real AUC/logloss and pairedUID intervals for every stratum; original cohort separately; FreshCurrent residual primary0.5 auxiliary0.1/1; actual paid observations/installations and full preparation/service FLOPs
protocol.limits: Development expansion, not sealed confirmation; population census is not30000 model replays; enriched quality/cost not a population prevalence estimate
protocol.resources: CPU timestamp scan about1-3min;8UID canary then runtime-estimated fourGPU replay. No training, theta3, ten-layer or new data windows

excursion_protocol.purpose: First-risk-excursion fallback on actual requests, tied to the pre-existing severe-error endpoint
excursion_protocol.failure_driving_change: Known UID139390 M4 first-request calibrated score0.039<0.053, later actual-query score0.576; first-request-only cadence misses query-dependent failure
excursion_protocol.screen: unchanged evidence_01 observed_bound or full_score90% calibration; compare both coordinate choices without refitting or threshold search
excursion_protocol.cadence: share actual C reads until first threshold excursion perUID/target; then pay exactly one target reconstruction, regardless of whether installed; no more probes this release
excursion_protocol.commit: actual max absolute logit residual strictly above0.5, the already fixed primary severe-error definition; replace earlier proxy-quantile tolerance0.043; no labeled AUC used in decisions
excursion_protocol.semantics: pre-read action after causal writes, before read-only revision assertion; reuse chosen logit and constructed KV; next release resets observation eligibility
excursion_protocol.limits: declined observation does not certify later queries; at most one reconstruction perUID/release is a call-count bound, not a hard global FLOP guarantee
excursion_protocol.population: 8UID canaries;512 natural each; extend numerically correct feasible candidates to2048 and512cap32/128, preserving all outcomes
excursion_protocol.controls: existing first-use policies and same-background evidence; benchmark goals unchanged; no per-user exceptions for the known UID

reference_semantics: Witness is Current-exact at construction, then a native target trajectory; subsequent discrepancies are not FreshCurrent errors

margin_protocol.stage: Additional development candidate after expanded frozen AUC results; not confirmation
margin_protocol.rule: At original commit only, install iff max(delta)-min(delta)>0.5 over held-bank16 plus current request candidates
margin_protocol.delta: Target construction logit minus current adapted logit; no feedback labels
margin_protocol.fixed: C,H,calibration,screen threshold,actual residual threshold,cohorts and cost denominator unchanged
margin_protocol.replay: Replay every UID with any frozen commit through the full lifetime; unchanged UIDs are exactly identical by induction since the new gate is only called at a frozen commit
margin_protocol.evaluation: All4082 users retained; natural/enriched separate; all original quality, tail and cost metrics
margin_protocol.canary: Existing opened failure users; exact pairwise-margin identity; full state replay
margin_protocol.budget: 34 affected users at prior 8-user canary56.74s implies about241s serial; no training

provenance_note: Protocol attached after completion; numerical runner unchanged; initial run_scan source hash retained
